full_judgment: 4. Mr. M. A. Wahab the learned Deputy Attorney General appeared on behalf of the State. He supported the order passed by the learned Sessions Judge and submits that no illegality has been committed by the learned Sessions Judge in extending the time for investigation. According to him the Sessions Judge had jurisdiction to extend time and there was no limitation as to extension of time. It is correct that investigation was not completed within 30 days from the date of lodging the F.I R. nor the same was completed within the extended period of 30 days granted by the Magistrate whereupon the investigating officer prayed before the Sessions Judge for further extension of time for investigation as per provision of section 167.
